CRITICAL.name: data_freshness_breach
CRITICAL.condition: Pipeline has not run in more than 24 hours
CRITICAL.message: Data freshness has breached the SLO of 24 hours. Stale data is impacting financial reports.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate and restart the pipeline immediately.

CRITICAL.name: data_quality_breach
CRITICAL.message: Data quality has breached the SLO of 99.9%. Erroneous financial insights may result.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate and resolve data quality issues immediately.

CRITICAL.name: row_count_breach
CRITICAL.condition: Row count is outside the range of 17 to 25
CRITICAL.message: Row count is outside the SLO bounds of 17 to 25. Data completeness is impacted.

WARNING.name: runtime_approaching_limit
WARNING.message: Pipeline runtime is approaching the SLO limit of 120 minutes. Dashboard update may be delayed.

WARNING.name: data_quality_slightly_below_threshold
WARNING.condition: Data quality percentage is slightly below 99.9%
WARNING.message: Data quality is slightly below the SLO of 99.9%. Investigate potential issues.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate and address potential data quality issues.

WARNING.name: merchant_failure_spike
WARNING.condition: One merchant's failure rate spikes above 30%
WARNING.message: One merchant's failure rate has spiked above 30%. Investigate the cause.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate and resolve the issue for the affected merchant.

INFO.name: new_payment_method
INFO.condition: A new payment method is seen in the data
INFO.message: A new payment method has been detected in the data.
INFO.recommended_action: Log the new payment method for future reference.

INFO.name: row_count_near_bounds
INFO.condition: Daily row count is near the SLO bounds
INFO.message: Daily row count is near the SLO bounds of 17 to 25. Monitor for potential issues.
INFO.recommended_action: Monitor row count for any potential issues.
